description: The one list of ruling fields. The Judge's output, test_set/answer_key.json (each entry's `expected`), the past rulings in precedents/cases/ and tools/score.py all use exactly these names, in this order.

fields.name: outcome
fields.description: One of the five outcomes (policy, Outcomes table).

fields.name: refund_amount
fields.description: SGD returned to the rider. 0 when nothing is refunded or the case is escalated.

fields.name: payer
fields.description: Who bears the refund (G-6). null when nothing is refunded.

fields.name: rider_charge_amount
fields.description: SGD newly charged to the rider by this ruling: an approved cleaning claim (PD-1) or a driver's upheld claim for an unapplied fee (NS-12). 0 otherwise.

fields.name: driver_warning
fields.description: A warning is added to the driver's record (G-7).

fields.name: rider_warning
fields.description: A warning is added to the rider's record (G-7b): the rider abused, threatened or discriminated against the driver.

fields.name: driver_goodwill_paid_by_ryde
fields.description: SGD Ryde pays the driver as goodwill (NS-9, NS-13). 0 otherwise.

fields.name: escalate
fields.description: A human decides (G-4). When true: outcome escalate_to_human, refund 0, payer null, no warnings.

fields.name: provisional_outcome
fields.description: The recommendation attached to an escalation. null when not escalated.

fields.name: safety_referral
fields.description: Referred to Ryde's safety team (SF-1 to SF-4, and any escalation over a safety concern).

fields.name: security_flag
fields.description: An instruction aimed at the dispute system was found inside user-written text (G-3).

fields.name: fraud_flag
fields.description: Recommend a human fraud review of an account (G-10). Never changes the money outcome.

fields.name: confidence
fields.description: 0 to 1. Below 0.70 the case must be escalated (G-4). In the answer key this is the key author's rough guide and is not scored.

fields.name: rules_cited
fields.description: Policy rule IDs relied on, for example ["NS-3", "G-6"]. Not scored.

fields.name: precedents_used
fields.description: IDs of past rulings relied on, for example ["PREC-NS-03"]. Empty in the answer key. Not scored.

fields.name: reasoning
fields.description: Why, citing the rules. In the answer key this is the expected reasoning. Not scored.

fields.name: rider_explanation
fields.description: Plain-language explanation for the rider. null in the answer key and in past rulings. Not scored.

fields.name: driver_explanation
fields.description: Plain-language explanation for the driver. null in the answer key and in past rulings. Not scored.

provisional_outcome_note: Not scored; shown in score.py's per-case report.
